findings.issue: Skip-to-main anchor changes the hash route to #main and returns users to the workspace directory.
findings.requestedFix: Preserve the route and move focus to main directly.

findings.issue: Freshness initially depends only on request errors; hidden tabs stop polling while recorded activity can remain presented without a stale indication.
findings.requestedFix: Derive freshness from observedAt and visibility, and mark or refresh old snapshots on resume.

findings.issue: Field uses a truthy fallback and presents valid numeric zero, including initial task version, as missing.
findings.requestedFix: Use a nullish or explicit empty-value fallback.

findings.issue: Shared succeeded label presents Run completion as accepted, although Task acceptance requires subsequent checks/review/integration.
findings.requestedFix: Use execution-complete wording for Run status and accepted wording only for actual Task acceptance.

findings.issue: Unresponsive runtime result previously prevented cleanup and bounded Host shutdown.
Scheduler previously selected capacity and roles from Runs without accounting for discussion leases.
Per-delta redaction leaked credentials split across output chunks.
History pagination discarded earlier Turn state and chunks, removing old running Turn stop/error affordances.
Live conversation activity initially lacked a stale indication after synchronization failures.
Incompatible Skill reservation previously left a poison queued request that could block unrelated scheduling.
SSE resync previously reconnected using an expired cursor indefinitely; now closes and reopens after a fresh snapshot.
Independent resync/poll/history requests can return out of order and currently replace newer snapshot/entity versions with older ones.
Connection verification was not owned by shutdown and could write to a closed store; verification now serializes, aborts and cleans up before Host closure.
Nonstandard credential reference environment names were not covered by generic redaction; explicit registered references now cover values and rotation.
Detached external worktree could not be re-associated because of path uniqueness; existing association now reactivates safely.
Late startup cleanup did not contribute a receipt, retaining capacity unnecessarily; confirmed late disposer now releases the lease.
Repository-free Task Run startup could hang beyond its deadline; startup now races cancellation and retains uncertainty until late cleanup evidence.
An interrupted integration preparation without a review Run could be treated as safe; its own process receipt or trusted reboot proof is now mandatory.
Detach could hide an unfinished external move; status and pending path now prevent detaching or re-associating an unresolved move.
Concurrent detach during asynchronous takeover checks bypassed the initial version check. A transactional recheck now precedes Git movement; concurrent archival is also guarded.
Verification startup timeout before a handle existed could appear cleaned up. Uncertainty now blocks additional verification or creation until a late owned disposer confirms completion.

limitations: The independent reviewer made no real model calls, no commits and no primary implementation edits. Parent real-model and browser evidence is separately attributed above.
Independent 32-case suite uses real HTTP/SQLite/Git with controlled execution/faults. It is not itself a claim that every external model or provider is compatible.
Parent owns the final whole-repository regression/build and interactive browser acceptance; this artifact records independently executed targeted checks and reviewed parent evidence.
Native support is deliberately pinned to the verified app-server/model/catalog boundary. Skill resource/script execution is explicitly unsupported where adapters cannot honor it.

Output is buffered and redacted before publication; no claim of token-by-token streaming. Unknown side effects require actual disposal receipt or trusted same-machine reboot evidence and are not force-released on Host restart.
OS IME composition and formal accessibility certification were not performed; exact automated and interactive coverage is recorded in A5 and X5.
No known remaining implementation blocker from the final plan cross-check; documented compatibility limits are not hidden as successful support.
